not_for: Graphic Designers looking for page layout tools like InDesign

prerequisites.recommended: Familiarity with saving and organizing files on a PC

overview.positioning: Stop wrestling with formatting and start creating professional documents effortlessly.
overview.short_description: Learn comprehensive document formatting, styles, templates, and mail merge in Microsoft Word.
what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Format long reports consistently using Styles
Create reusable corporate letterheads and templates
Generate automated mass mailings using Mail Merge
Insert and format tables, graphics, and smart art professionally

why_now.industry_shift: Despite new tools, Word remains the global standard for formal business documentation.
why_now.ai_impact: AI can draft text, but human operators are still needed to format it into compliant corporate documents.
why_now.business_demand: Poorly formatted documents look unprofessional; businesses require staff who can produce polished work.
why_now.career_opportunity: Essential baseline skill for almost every desk job globally.

learning_outcomes: FORMAT: Text and paragraphs cleanly without using spacebar alignment
STRUCTURE: Long documents using Styles and automated Tables of Contents
AUTOMATE: Bulk document creation via Mail Merge
DESIGN: Visually appealing reports using tables and graphics

stages.name: Structuring
stages.desc: Applying Styles for headings and body

business_use_cases.approach: Create and enforce a standardized Word Template using locked Styles

ai_integration.ai_cannot_replace: Nuanced layout decisions and template creation

best_practices: Always use Styles for formatting, never manual highlights and sizing
Use Page Breaks, not hitting Enter repeatedly to start a new page
Turn on 'Show/Hide ¶' to troubleshoot formatting issues

common_mistakes.mistake: Using the spacebar to align text
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Use Tabs, Indents, or invisible Tables for perfect alignment

career_paths.employer_expectations: Produce error-free, neatly formatted documents quickly
career_paths.what_student_demonstrates: A polished business report with automated elements

freelance_applications.client_workflow: Receive Draft -> Apply Styles/Formatting -> Return PDF/Word File

what_you_will_build: A 10-page Business Report with a Table of Contents
final_deliverables: A comprehensive styled document and a Mail Merge output file

assessment.criteria: Correct use of Styles, tabs, and layout tools (no manual spacing)

faq.question: Does this cover Word for Mac?
faq.answer: Yes, while the interface differs slightly, the core concepts like Styles and Mail Merge apply to both.
